# NFL.com

> > Official site of the National Football League featuring live scores, news, stats, and coverage of Super Bowl LX, the 2026 NFL Draft, and flag football's Olympic debut at LA28.

NFL.com serves as the league's digital hub for fans worldwide, offering real-time game coverage, player statistics, draft information, and international programming including NFL Game Pass. The site covers major initiatives like flag football's inclusion in the 2028 Olympic Games in Los Angeles and provides resources for teams like the Seattle Seahawks and New England Patriots.

## Key Topics

- NFL Game Pass
- Super Bowl LX
- 2026 NFL Draft
- Flag Football
- LA28 / 2028 Olympic Games
- NFL Research & Statistics
- Seattle Seahawks
- New England Patriots
- International Competition
- Roger Goodell
- NFL Players Association
- International Federation of American Football (IFAF)
- Canada NFL Programming
- NFL Combine
- Pro Days

## Live Scores & Game Coverage

- [Live NFL Scores 2025](https://www.nfl.com/scores): Live NFL scores, real-time highlights, and game results for 2025 season

## Major Events

- [Super Bowl LX | UK](https://www.nfl.com/uk/super-bowl): Super Bowl LX UK viewing guide for Channel 5, Sky Sports, and DAZN
- [2026 NFL Draft Registration](https://www.nfl.com/draft/event-info/registration): 2026 NFL Draft registration and event info for Pittsburgh
- [2026 NFL Combine Security Procedures](https://www.nfl.com/combine/event-info/security-procedures): NFL Combine security procedures and prohibited items at Lucas Oil Stadium

## Flag Football & Olympic Programming

- [Flag Football is LA28 Bound](https://www.nfl.com/flag-football/la28): Flag football's inclusion in 2028 Olympic Games in Los Angeles
- [NFL FLAG Canada](https://www.nfl.com/ca/flag): NFL FLAG Canada youth flag football tournaments and championships

## Draft & Scouting Coverage

- [2023 NFL Pro Days](https://www.nfl.com/draft/pro-days): NFL Pro Days schedule, previews, and draft prospect scouting coverage

## Research & Statistics

- [NFL Research](https://www.nfl.com/news/nfl-research): NFL Research statistics, records, milestones, and weekly analysis

## Podcasts & Media

- [NFL Films: Tales from the Vault](https://www.nfl.com/podcasts/nfl-films-tales-from-the-vault): Andrea Kremer hosts NFL Films podcast with legendary player interviews

## Optional

- [Canada Merchandise Giveaway Official Rules](https://www.nfl.com/international/canada/merchandise-giveaway-official-rules-snap-it-back): Official rules for NFL Canada merchandise giveaway contest
- [Mobile App Terms (French)](https://www.nfl.com/_mobile-app/terms-fr): French terms of service for NFL mobile app and services
